Taylor Ng: Hey team — excited to be here! I9m Taylor (Platform PM). First day checklist Q: who should I ping to get VPN + repo access? Also any estimate on the laptop delivery window? :smile:

Taylor Ng: thanks Kevin. macbook please. dropping ssh key here:
```
ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIJl... taylor@personal
```

Maria Gomez: team lunch at 12 is the perfect intro 35f see you there. Also adding a note to order a standing desk converter if you prefer.
Kevin Chu: my money9s on Iceland being true, spicy food lie? Hard to tell. Also +1 for lunchtime onboarding.
Taylor Ng: reveal: I did backpack Iceland and I9m terrible with spicy food (sweating on mild salsa counts?). so the lie is the stand-up set (yet!). Thanks for the warm welcome, I9ll follow up with eng-infra and Seth.
OnboarderBot: Welcome packet delivered to Taylor Ng. IT ticket #IT-4582 opened for asset tracking. Reminder: complete security training by day 5.
Maria Gomez: also, if you want any specific stickers, reply with the names and I9ll include them in the desk drop.
Taylor Ng: please send the Redwood ramen sticker and the "i ❤️ low-latency" sticker if you have it :ramen: :sparkles:
